Start with the setup notebook, then follow the modules in order. Every notebook loads its own data and can be opened cold.

{{< include /_includes/notebooks.md >}}

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
Notebooks are stored without outputs. Choose **Runtime → Run all** in Colab, or run the cells one at a time as you work through the exercises.
:::

## How the labs are laid out

- **Setup cell.** Installs and imports. Run it first.
- **Exercises.** Each has a `# TODO` cell for you to complete.
- **Solutions.** Folded directly beneath each exercise. Try the exercise first, then open the solution to compare.
- **Checkpoints.** A cell after each exercise that passes or fails, so you know where you stand.
- **Stretch.** An optional final section. Nothing later depends on it.

API keys are optional. See [Setup](setup.qmd).
